transcript: Tell your child this, if you want good things in life, remember what truly shapes a person. Be careful who you walk with. Those who only drink and waste their days will slowly pull you into the same stillness. Energy travels. Choose wisely. Keep learning. The world does not wait for anyone. Only those who continue to learn are able to move forward with it. Take responsibility for your life. Do not wait for someone to rescue you. The moment you take ownership, your path begins to open. Treat money with respect. When you earn, do not use it to impress. Use it to build stability, peace and freedom. Stay close to your inner stillness. There will be days when strength runs out. On those days, a quiet breath will carry you further than force ever could. Be grateful. Remember who stood beside you when it was not easy. Do not forget the ones who stayed and learn to give. Serve without keeping score. Give from the heart. Life has its own way of returning what is offered with sincerity. These are not lessons you memorize once. They are truths you return to, again and again. That is what the 30-day healing journey was created for. A quiet daily practice of living what matters. It's in the link in my bio.
